label: FREE GUIDE
headline: Confused by marketing speak? Get clarity now.
body: This free guide explains 102 internet marketing terms, from A to Z, in plain English.
caption: Ever feel like you need a translator for all the marketing jargon out there? You're not alone! Words like SEO, funnel, CTA, and CTR can sometimes sound like a different language. Our new free guide, 'The Internet Marketing Dictionary,' cuts through the noise. It breaks down 102 common marketing terms from A to Z, using simple, everyday language.
